name: Zain - Sore wa, aragaenai shoudou -
original_name: ザイン -それは、抗えない衝動-
source: Zai, a slave who was once a complete gladiator, is assigned to guard the Duke Vermer's heir, Darc. Yet for some, this became a nightmare... and for others, the opening act to an unknown truth. Duke Vermer, rumored to be a lover of men. Darc, whispered about as a pleasure-seeker. Fei, lamenting his own unfortunate upbringing. Zai, staking his hopes on what it means to be human. Where will their paths lead? To death, or to something more?
translation: 扎伊是一名奴隶，曾经是一名彻底的角斗士，被指派看守维默公爵的继承人达尔克。然而对于一些人来说，这变成了一场噩梦……而对于另一些人来说，这是未知真相的开场。维默公爵，传闻是男人的情人。达尔克，低声说他是一个寻欢作乐的人。费先生感叹自己的不幸成长。Zai，将他的希望寄托在人类的意义上。他们的道路将通向何方？是为了死亡，还是为了别的什么？
